BMS AI Agent — ask BMS datanorth_east

Ask about orders, invoices, GP or vendors and get a finance-accurate answer back as a table or chart — no SQL, no waiting on a report.

SHIPPED
  • ✓Built & deployed the BMS Agent (Cloud Run · Gemini) — composable analytics: any measure × brand × region × period. live
  • ✓Every figure finance-accurate — credit-note netting (GP corrected ~15%) + void-PO exclusion. −15% GP fix
  • ✓Interactive charts, an eval harness & role-based access; runs at ~$2/mo.
  • →Next · Mirror NetSuite (SuiteQL → BigQuery) beside BMS in the same agent — read-only, near-zero added cost.
  • →Next · Per-user data scoping + usage/cost logging; extend netting to AR and align sales-credit to finance's rule.

Remittance Recognition — match payments to invoicesnorth_east

Turn a bank statement into confirmed, NetSuite-ready customer payments — automatically.

SHIPPED
  • ✓AI statement extraction — upload a bank PDF/CSV and Gemini pulls the transactions; Citibank CSV parsed directly (no AI cost).
  • ✓Auto-matching engine — scores each deposit against open invoices (amount + company name) and surfaces the best candidates for one-click confirm.
  • ✓NetSuite export — builds the Customer Payment CSV with RV numbers, FX rates, bank charges, credit notes & interest income, ready to import.

SHIPPED
  • ✓Shared MCP data endpoint — 15 governed tools over a read-only mirror; no VPN, no SQL for users. 15 tools
  • ✓Single source of truth — an improvement reaches the skill and the agent instantly; JWT auth + per-module RBAC.
  • →Next · MCP for NetSuite — extend the same governed pattern to NetSuite data.
